title: profiles.set_display_name
description: Payload for the profiles.set_display_name comm Function — write the CANONICAL display name of a user, performed by profiles on another module's authority (the caller's edge already authorized it; see billing.debit for the same shape). The provider runs this module's own validate_display_name canon, resolves the swappable profile model, creates the row if absent and publishes profile.changed. Returns {"ok": bool, "display_name": str|null, "reason": str|null}; reason is the trailing name of a profiles error key (display_name_too_short | display_name_forbidden_chars | display_name_emoji | display_name_invisible_chars) or no_display_name_field when the deployment's profile model carries no display_name at all. No idempotency key: the write is last-write-wins on one field, so at-least-once delivery is harmless.
